Package:dji.v5.manager.aircraft.perception.data

Get whether the main switch of obstacle avoidance is turned on.

Note
This interface has been deprecated since MSDK 5.1.0. Please call getObstacleAvoidanceType to get whether the obstacle avoidance switch is enabled. For millimeter wave radar accessories, you need to call getObstacleAvoidanceEnabled to get whether the obstacle avoidance switch is enabled.

Return

NameDescription
booleanReturn whether the main switch of obstacle avoidance is turned on.
